ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 5 — Preventive Visit — Natsume Sōseki — True-date frame: synthetic events are moved into the patient's historical lifetime. Codes, instruments, and treatments remain modern and are anachronistic.

code.displayName: Periodic reevaluation and management of healthy individual

text.paragraph: Mr. Natsume is a 43-year-old novelist with a gastric ulcer and Helicobacter pylori infection diagnosed four weeks ago, on vonoprazan and oral iron, who comes for the preventive visit booked at his first appointment. He finishes the eradication course tomorrow. His stomach pain has gone and he has had no black, tarry stools since before the endoscopy; the iron makes his stools dark but formed. His back is much better after five days of heat and walking, and he has needed acetaminophen only twice. He is close to the end of the newspaper serial and is pacing himself. He has no new concerns. [S]

Voluntary advance care planning discussion of about 20 minutes, with his consent. He wants full treatment, including transfusion and endoscopic or surgical treatment, if the ulcer bleeds again. He named a health care agent, recorded in the confidential part of the chart and not named here, and chose not to record other treatment preferences today. To be revisited yearly. [S]
